title: Spicy Cashew Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Mexican stew made with cashews and a blend of spices. The stew is rich and comforting, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, and chili powder, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
